class.name: NNAngleVector2Sensor
class.brief_description: Accepts two vectors, calculates the angle between them and scales it to [code]0..1[/code] range.
class.description: Calculates the signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] via [method Vector2.angle_to], clamps it to the configured range, and normalises it so [member min_angle_radian] maps to [code]0.0[/code] and [member max_angle_radian] maps to [code]1.0[/code]. A range whose minimum is greater than or equal to its maximum scores [code]0.0[/code].

members.member: The angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in degrees, clamped to [member min_angle_degrees] and [member max_angle_degrees]. Updated when the sensor is evaluated.
The angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in radians, clamped to [member min_angle_radian] and [member max_angle_radian]. Updated when the sensor is evaluated.
Reference direction vector for the signed angle calculation ([code]from_vector.angle_to(to_vector)[/code]), for example the facing direction of an AI entity.

The maximum signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in degrees, corresponding to [code]1.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Automatically updates [member max_angle_radian].

The maximum signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in radians, corresponding to [code]1.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Automatically updates [member max_angle_degrees].

The minimum signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in degrees, corresponding to [code]0.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Automatically updates [member min_angle_radian].

The minimum signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] in radians, corresponding to [code]0.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Automatically updates [member min_angle_degrees].

Target direction vector compared against [member from_vector] via [method Vector2.angle_to], for example the direction toward the closest enemy entity. Swapping [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] negates the resulting signed angle.
